interval_policy: Half-open scoring windows, 400Hz decision samples for allocation events; 800Hz states for tracking.
measurement_policy: Estimated feedback errors are primary, as agreed in prior discussion; true plant errors reported alongside. No post-flight translation or phase alignment.
authority_policy: Read axis_capacity_nm from ca_priority_direction_protocol: sum(abs(nominal hover torque matrix).*command_upper). This is model authority, not measured CUAV airframe authority.
disturbance_policy: Only the new roll sinusoid; remove inherited F8 external yaw load. Use native series interpolation with a deterministic smooth sinusoid, not a random disturbance.
same_controller_and_sensors: Call ppid_config, ppid_noise, ppid_simulate, ppid_control_step unchanged. Only scenario duration/reference/disturbance differ.

precheck.role: Engineering screening definitions fixed before first run; no assertion of flight clearance. Predictor must meet lambda target and remain valid. Failed attempts retained.

recovery.definition: First time after22s that estimated horizontal distance<=0.2m, horizontal speed<=0.2m/s and abs(estimated roll)<=2deg persist for0.5s within22-32s. Report missing if not reached. Also report maximum deviations and opposite-side overshoot projected onto the position/roll deviation at22s.

allowed_development_adjustments: Seed501 only. If lambda entirely1, increase load to90% or yaw peak to300deg/s. If mode1>5% or divergence, reduce load to80%, then75%. All changed settings require a new output_tag and a fresh PINV/predictor pair. If nontrivial lambda exists but target missed without an authorized adjustment trigger, stop and report; do not launch formal batch.
formal_gate: Both same-configuration seed501 PINV and PCA_PREDICTIVE prechecks must pass before source lock. Formal includes development seed501 explicitly, not an independent holdout confirmation.
